message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The facts: Husband repeatedly beats wife, on June 26 2016 he beats her, she falls into river and drowns. Autopsy shows injuries consistent with assault and strangulation, causing death. So the death is caused by intentional assault leading to death. In Chinese criminal law, this could be "故意伤害致人死亡罪" (intentional injury resulting in death) which is a form of homicide. Also "虐待家庭成员罪" (domestic violence) maybe separate. The prosecution says: "故意伤害他人，致人轻伤，并虐待家庭成员，情节恶劣，致使被害人死亡". So crimes: "故意伤害致人死亡罪" (intentional injury causing death) and "虐待家庭成员罪". Possibly also "故意杀人罪"? But the injuries are from assault, not premeditated killing. In Chinese law, if the act is intentional injury that leads to death, it's "故意伤害致人死亡罪" (Article 234). Also "虐待家庭成员罪" (Article 260). So answer: [罪名]故意伤害致人死亡;虐待家庭成员<eoa>
